title: feat(nsopn): opposite-lock formdraw n(C)!=n(D): reverse UNDEFINED, face UNDEFINED
science: Opposite-lock x-probes, strictly-earlier kernel. First member of the mu*-split sub-family: mu* is defined as the first axis where n(C)!=n(D), letter=sign(n_mu*). Here n(C)_2=0 vs n(D)_2=1/3, so the very component chosen to split C from D is zero at C and C is UNDEFINED. Face cannot be certified.
